metadata.title: PHP 2026 critical remote code execution vulnerabilities
metadata.summary: Detects supported PHP release lines below the upstream fixes for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.
metadata.author: PatchRover maintainers

sources.title: PHP security advisory: critical remote code execution vulnerabilities

matchers.name: php
matchers.notes: PHP 8.1 and older require distribution or LTS-vendor evidence and therefore remain unknown rather than being declared fixed or unaffected.

remediation.summary: Update every web-serving PHP runtime to the fixed release for its supported line or to an explicitly supported vendor backport, then rebuild and redeploy every affected artifact.
steps: Inventory every PHP web runtime, including PHP-FPM, mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, and LiteSpeed deployments.
Update to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, or 8.2.35 as appropriate, or obtain explicit fixed-package evidence from the operating-system or LTS vendor.
Rebuild images from clean inputs and deploy them through the normal reviewed release process.
Do not treat the published interim mitigations as complete remediation.
tests: Run the application's unit, integration, and request-handling regression tests against the updated runtime.
Confirm extensions, FPM pools, web-server integration, upload limits, sessions, and error handling still behave as intended.
operationalChecks: Observe the fixed PHP version in the built artifact.
Observe a new running image digest for every affected workload.
Confirm that no old replica, worker, cron job, or rollback target still uses the affected runtime.

requirements: Every relevant supported PHP line must meet its minimum fixed version.
At least one fixed runtime image digest must be observed for a production receipt.
Unsupported, EOL, vendor-backported, or unversioned runtimes remain unknown without explicit vendor evidence.
